title: I can now play my entire game with my voice
author: vimmerio
selftext: MicroDucks is a small farm sim I'm building in Unreal Engine 5.8: a flock of robot ducks, a herding dog, foxes and a farm stand. This week I made every input speakable. Hold a key and say "all ducks, sit down", "zoom in", "cinematic mode", "build a turret" or "follow the dog", and it happens. Everything runs locally on my GPU: → Speech to text: Whisper large-v3-turbo (whisper.cpp) → Understanding: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt, served with llama.cpp → Everyday commands (sit, stand, follow me) skip the model entirely. A small grammar handles them in under a millisecond. Freer phrasing like "could you all head back to the coop" goes to Nemotron and comes back in about a third of a second!
